data.title: Tony Wang Discusses CrowdStrike-Zscaler Deal and AI Trade
data.description: Tony Wang, a portfolio manager for T. Rowe Price’s Science and Technology Equity Strategy, was asked whether the AI cycle has changed and whether recent declines present a buying opportunity. He also flagged Wednesday’s PCE inflation report as a potential market catalyst, according to Bloomberg. Wang spoke with Romaine Bostick on “The Close.”

data.title: AI | Scribe CEO Jennifer Smith Cites Workplace AI Use Below 4%
data.description: Scribe co-founder and CEO Jennifer Smith, a former McKinsey consultant, cited research showing AI use for workplace tasks is below 4%, according to Bloomberg. She said the findings contrast with the widespread chatbot and AI use she observes in her own circle. Smith discussed AI valuations and adoption with Romaine Bostick on “The Close.”

data.title: CryptoBilis Attacker Transfers 25,000 ETH to Tornado Cash
data.description: The CryptoBilis attacker has transferred a cumulative 25,000 ETH, worth about $58.74 million, to Tornado Cash. According to Odaily, Arkham reported that Tether froze another $10 million linked to the CryptoBilis Ledger theft. The incident involved 1,486 Ledger user addresses from October 7 to 9 and caused losses of about $95.35 million. Apart from the frozen funds, the remaining assets have been moved out of the associated addresses.

data.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Demand Drives Internet Providers to Their Busiest Day Ever
data.description: Internet providers had their busiest day ever as record demand for Grand Theft Auto VI sent US internet traffic soaring this week, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: DCG’s Zcash Miner Fortitude Clears Vote for Nasdaq Listing as ZEC Retreats From All-Time High
data.description: DCG’s Zcash miner Fortitude cleared a hurdle toward a Nasdaq listing after HeartSciences shareholders approved their merger. About 86% of votes at Thursday’s meeting backed the deal, according to The Block, citing a Friday release from Fortitude. Nasdaq approval is still required; the combined company will be named Fortitude Mining Group and expects to trade as TUDE, with no listing date set. ZEC traded around $753 on Friday, down roughly 55% from its $1,680 all-time high reached about two months ago.

data.title: AI | Victor Peng Sees AI and Quantum Computing as Long-Term Opportunities
data.description: PsiQuantum CEO Victor Peng, a former Advanced Micro Devices president, sees AI and quantum computing as long-term opportunities. He said quantum computing and optical switching could lower compute costs on “Bloomberg The Close,” according to Bloomberg.

data.title: STOCKS | Goldman Sachs Sees Selloff Extending as Panic Gauge Nears Maximum
data.description: According to Bloomberg, Goldman Sachs’ panic gauge climbed close to its maximum as US stocks tumbled Friday. The bank’s traders said another substantial wave of selling is likely over the coming week.

data.title: Trump Defends Relationship With Putin, Says Russian Leader Wants to End Ukraine War
data.description:
According to Sina Finance, U.S. President Donald Trump defended his relationship with Russian President Vladimir Putin despite Russia’s latest deadly attacks, repeatedly saying Putin wants to end the war in Ukraine. At a White House news conference on Friday, Trump called ending the conflict difficult, praised his meeting with Putin this week, and called the Russian leader “my friend.” He declined to say whether Putin was a friend of the United States.

Trump said it was too early to discuss what security guarantees the United States might offer Ukraine, which Kyiv considers necessary for any peace deal. He declined to say whether Washington would provide guarantees similar to NATO’s, saying an agreement must come first. Jared Kushner, Trump’s son-in-law, said on Thursday that Trump was open to strong security guarantees. Trump has said he would not reach a deal with Putin without Ukraine’s participation, though he previously described Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy as a greater obstacle to peace.

The uncertainty has unsettled Ukraine and its allies, who fear Trump could pressure Kyiv to accept difficult territorial or security concessions or begin talks on Europe-wide collective security arrangements. Ukraine’s allies say discussions about Europe’s overall security cannot begin before Russia stops fighting. Hours after Trump and Putin held their first in-person meeting in more than a year, Zelenskyy said an attack had disrupted electricity, water and heating in Kyiv and other parts of Ukraine.

The attack followed Putin’s threat of forceful retaliation for a Ukrainian strike that damaged a key bridge connecting Russia with occupied Crimea. Putin also ruled out a partial ceasefire. Trump said he believed the conflict would be resolved, while adding that he did not know whether Putin would say so publicly because it might be unsuitable from a negotiating standpoint.

data.title: Microsoft (MSFT.O) Begins Deploying Fix Expected to Reach Users Within Hours
data.description: According to Jin10, Microsoft has begun deploying a fix that is expected to reach users within hours.

data.title: OIS Contracts No Longer Fully Price a 25-Basis-Point Fed Rate Hike in December
data.description:
According to Sina Finance, stronger safe-haven demand extended the rally in short-term U.S. Treasuries, while overnight index swaps tied to Federal Reserve meeting dates priced in just 23 basis points of rate-hike premium for the December policy meeting. That was down from 27 basis points priced at the start of the week for the policy statement due on December 9.

Further along the OIS curve, dovish repricing continued. Markets now fully price a second 25-basis-point rate hike for the Federal Reserve’s meeting in March next year, after previously coming close to fully pricing it in for January. Markets now expect the policy rate to peak at around 4.5% by the middle of next year, compared with a peak of 4.75% priced in at the start of this week.

data.title: AI | Cognition in Funding Talks at $75 Billion Valuation
data.description: Cognition AI Inc. is in funding talks at a $75 billion valuation, just two months after announcing its most recent funding round, according to Bloomberg, citing people familiar with the matter.

data.title: JPMorgan Fields Bids Below 80 Cents for Qualtrics-Linked Debt
data.description: JPMorgan Chase is fielding offers below 80 cents on debt tied to an acquisition by Qualtrics International as it weighs a potential sale, Bloomberg reported.

data.title: Thinking Machines Releases Local AI Model Inkling 2 Mini
data.description: According to ChainCatcher, Thinking Machines has released Inkling 2 Mini, an AI model designed for local deployment. The approximately 20GB model can run on Apple silicon devices with at least 32GB of memory. It is released under the Apache 2.0 license and comes with a separate acceptable use policy that sets additional terms for its use.

data.title: WTI Crude Oil Rises to $85 per Barrel, Up 0.70% Intraday
data.description: According to Jin10, WTI crude oil rose to $85 per barrel, up 0.70% intraday.

data.title: STOCKS | Former Nvidia Employees Raised Complaints About Huang Years Ago
data.description:
Bloomberg News semiconductor reporter Ian King said a lawsuit by two former Nvidia employees illustrates the costs employees bore amid the company’s success under former CEO Jensen Huang. Huang is facing scrutiny following allegations of multiple affairs, according to Bloomberg.

Huang’s representatives said the allegations in the complaint date back a long time and do not reflect his behavior or how he is viewed inside Nvidia.

data.title: AI TRENDS | Anthropic (ANT.O) IPO Reportedly Draws $115 Billion-$120 Billion in Retail Demand
data.description: According to Jin10, Anthropic's (ANT.O) IPO reportedly attracted about $115 billion to $120 billion in retail demand.

data.title: Strategy IR Head Says Anthropic IPO Is a Negative Catalyst for Bitcoin Pullback
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, Strategy investor relations head Chaitanya “CJ” Jain said the Anthropic IPO had been a clear negative catalyst for Bitcoin over the past two weeks, as risk-seeking capital shifted toward AI-related trades. He made the remarks on Bitcoin Magazine TV as Bitcoin traded below Strategy’s average purchase price, and said he expects the rotation to reverse.

Jain said currency debasement could be a larger catalyst, with market participants likely to turn back to Bitcoin if central banks are forced to print money. He also discussed MSCI’s removal of Strategy from its indexes, STRC’s resilience during the Bitcoin selloff, nearly $3 billion in company STRC repurchases, the rationale for maintaining STRC’s 12% rate, S&P’s B- credit rating, and addressed long-term MSTR investors.

data.title: AI | Asset-Backed Debt Sales Set Third Straight Post-GFC High
data.description: According to Bloomberg, asset-backed securities sales have reached a post-GFC high for a third straight year, as builders of artificial intelligence infrastructure tap markets for financing and cash-rich insurance firms seek high-yielding debt.

data.title: Apollo Taps 13 Wall Street Banks for $9 Billion ADT Debt Package
data.description: According to Bloomberg, Apollo Global Management Inc. has enlisted 13 Wall Street lenders for a roughly $9 billion debt package it underwrote for Thrive Holdings Inc.’s acquisition of home security provider ADT Inc., according to people familiar with the matter.

data.title: OMERS Private Capital Head Michael Block to Become Teranet CEO
data.description: According to Bloomberg, Michael Block is leaving his role as head of private capital at the Ontario Municipal Employees Retirement System (OMERS) to become chief executive officer of Teranet Inc., one of OMERS’s infrastructure portfolio companies.
